desc: Derive the exact minimum stair-cost formula for a fixed route of building capacities.
Prove that optimizing over all grid routes reduces to a maximum-bottleneck connectivity problem.
Design the Kruskal reconstruction tree preprocessing.
Develop the per-query algorithm and handle same-building and endpoint cases.
Fix the reconstruction-tree root pointer bug and verify sample and edge-case correctness.
Review Python complexity, memory usage, and implementation details after the fix.
